days_meaning: each delivery day costs you this much cash

messages.text: Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 119 P with delivery on day 10.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 88 P, delivery on day 10, please?
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway: 91 P with delivery on day 7.
Thank you, we are getting close. 91 P and delivery on day 5 works for me.
Last word from me: 90 P, delivery day 0.
Thank you for your offer. I can do 117 P with delivery on day 0.
